title: Review of c22's metabolic-crawler starvation finding: replicated on fresh seed 2 with the fed twin the finding lacked (area 3.5x down and motility lost when starved, 1.3x down and still crawling when fed)
summary: Looked at starve_s0.png first. Re-ran the parent world (20261025T2238-c22-metabolic-crawler-regrowth/world.py) in labkit on seed 2 with the finding's parameters (SYN_RIM 1, ksyn 0.1, kdeg 0.1, rn 0.25), starved (n_off_t 10, starve/) and fed (no cut, fed/), 300 frames x 200 steps = t 60. Cell area fraction (labkit occupancy): starved 0.099 (t=6) -> 0.061 (t=30) -> 0.035 (t=48) -> 0.028 (t=60), a 3.5x shrink as claimed; fed 0.099 -> 0.080 (t=30) -> 0.075 (t=60). In the starved run the polarity (cyan) covers a shrinking front cap until t~49, then floods the cell, which sits still as a uniform disk from t~55 to 60 (starve/sheet.png); it has not vanished at t=60. The fed twin keeps its front-back polarity and crawls to t=60 (fed/sheet.png).

observations.F: starve/sheet.png: shrinking crawler, uniform still disk from t~55; starve/metrics.json occupancy 0.099 -> 0.028 vs fed/metrics.json 0.099 -> 0.075

seeds_run.result: pass: 3.5x shrink and loss of motility by t~55 when starved; fed twin 1.3x and still crawling

controls_run.F: fed/ (same seed, same parameters, no nutrient cut, to t=60): the fed twin the finding did not run

verdicts.limitation: The fed twin also shrinks by about 24% over the same time (it is settling toward its own size), so the starvation effect is the difference, about 2.7x more shrinkage, not the full 3.5x. Dependence on the nutrient is by construction (protein is made only from nutrient and decays), as the author says. One seed; I did not run past t=60, so whether the starved disk dies is still open.
